title: xDrip BG not up to date in AAPS
symptom: BGs coming from xDrip are correctly shown in the xDrip tab in AAPS but the main UI shows older BG. The trend at xDrip is not the same as in AAPS.
cause: After transmitter change, the data is not in 5 minute interval and gets recalculated, causing the delay. The issue occurs only when using xDrip; using BYODA everything is in sync.
fix: Update to the latest Dev build, as changes have been made to make this delay happen less frequently. A commit was referenced as a fix.
evidence_quote: Yes after transmitter change, the data is not in 5 minute interval and gets recalculated, that causes the delay. However after your build, changes has been made in dev to make this delay happen less frequent , so try to update to latest Dev and see if that fixes it
